The paper uses two layers; num_layers is an explicit experiment control. Residual post-LayerNorm, sigmoid(Dense(concat(user, cross_delta))) gating, affine biases, no dropout and no extra FFN are engineering choices where the paper omits details. Field-only component; no event history, tokenizer, readout, prediction head or full champion-model reproduction. Independent paper-based implementation; author repository and code license are unconfirmed, and no third-party code was copied. True means valid; padding is sanitized before arithmetic, including padded NaNs. Empty affected outputs are zero.

Item-conditioned outputs need recomputation for changed candidates. No sequence evolution, temporal features or final ranking score. Independent paper-based implementation; author repository and code license are unconfirmed, and no third-party code was copied. Independent per-domain attention follows the domain-indexed operator. Direct pooling, affine biases, no dropout and no extra FFN are declared engineering choices. Query generation adds no residual or LayerNorm after attention. An empty domain or empty context returns two zero probes with false masks. No downstream query-to-sequence encoding, token mixing or scoring head. Independent paper-based implementation; author repository and code license are unconfirmed, and no third-party code was copied. True means valid; padding is sanitized before arithmetic, including padded NaNs. Empty affected outputs are zero.

method_cards.source_model: RankUp representation diagnosis, original masked tensor probes
method_cards.mechanism: Measure per-sample entropy effective rank, stable rank, token-axis output variance and optional paired-branch cosine similarity on supplied intermediate layers.
method_cards.comparison: First collect diagnostics without changing predictions. Then compare one grouping, projection, sharing or interaction change against the same backbone using task quality and resource guardrails; do not maximize rank alone.
method_cards.failure_signals: No repeatable task gain after the controlled intervention, unsupported inputs, unstable or misleading diagnostics, invalid masking, loss of protected interaction signal or cost beyond budget.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Detached diagnostics only; no parameters, loss, automatic hooks or automatic collapse classification. Caller explicitly supplies intermediate states. Ranks use each sample token-by-channel matrix; variance uses valid-token population variance averaged over channels. Optional centering changes rank and cosine semantics. Zero input has rank zero by convention. Paired branch cosine requires aligned shapes; missing observations are not evidence of a bottleneck.

method_cards.source_model: TayFCS-inspired first-order saliency and protected screening, original implementation
method_cards.mechanism: Measure mean absolute activation-times-gradient scores and pairwise-common-valid cosine redundancy for supplied field or explicit-cross tensors; select deterministically under a budget while retaining protected indices and interaction groups.
method_cards.comparison: Keep all source fields of protected interactions. Compare full-input and screened candidates after matched retraining; ablate nominated groups and report slices, uncertainty and cost. Correlation alone never drops a field.
method_cards.failure_signals: No repeatable task gain after the controlled intervention, unsupported inputs, unstable or misleading diagnostics, invalid masking, loss of protected interaction signal or cost beyond budget.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: First-order diagnostic inspired by feature screening, not a complete TayFCS or LO-FAR reproduction; no automatic cross enumeration or causal-importance claim. Redundancy is absolute cosine over common valid observations, not a removal decision. Score rows may represent fields or explicit crosses; source-field lineage is caller-owned. select is eager/offline, uses stable index tie breaking, retains every protected group member, and rejects budgets below protected requirements. Protection must be supplied explicitly. Single-feature saliency can miss interaction-only value. Training-only screening must be followed by ablation and retraining; do not use final holdout labels for selection.

method_cards.mechanism: Rank directed field-token edges once by initial affinity, then allow nondecreasing edge counts across learned attention and FFN layers. The original ranking is reused throughout the forward pass.
method_cards.comparison: Using the same weights, dimensions and inputs, compare full-edge, fixed-sparse and progressive schedules. Keep downstream head, data split and optimizer fixed; ablate the schedule separately from width or depth.
method_cards.failure_signals: No repeatable task gain after the controlled intervention, unsupported inputs, unstable or misleading diagnostics, invalid masking, loss of protected interaction signal or cost beyond budget.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Original local mechanism inspired by MGDIN, not its multi-granularity full model or semantic-ID pipeline. Initial affinity uses scaled raw token dot products, with descending scores and stable row-major ties; it has no learned Q0/K0. Current layer Q/K/V projections are learned. Budgets count global directed edges including self edges, bounded by actual field_count squared. Empty attention rows get zero context; invalid fields stay zero. Sorting is discrete, not a learned differentiable gate.

method_cards.source_model: SIF-inspired per-event contextual representation, original continuous adapter
method_cards.mechanism: Project aligned event item and context features into a common space and combine them at each historical event, preserving event order and sanitizing padding.
method_cards.comparison: Compare item-only and item-plus-context encodings with the same history length, downstream encoder/head and training budget. Include context-shuffle or context-ablation controls.
method_cards.failure_signals: No repeatable task gain after the controlled intervention, unsupported inputs, unstable or misleading diagnostics, invalid masking, loss of protected interaction signal or cost beyond budget.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Continuous tanh fusion of item and context projections only; not SIF hierarchical quantization, codebook training or the complete SIF-Mixer. Caller supplies ordered, aligned, pre-decision features. This adapter adds no timestamps, position encoding or causal sequence mixing. Padding is zeroed before projections and after fusion; missing histories remain absent. No data is fetched or fabricated.

method_cards.mechanism: Use independent learned Q/K/V/output projections and separate softmax normalization for user-to-history, target-to-history and target-to-user attention.
method_cards.comparison: Hold encoders, head and training budget fixed; compare separate relation normalization with joint pooling and ablate one relation at a time. Keep target candidates independent.
method_cards.failure_signals: No repeatable task gain after the controlled intervention, unsupported inputs, unstable or misleading diagnostics, invalid masking, loss of protected interaction signal or cost beyond budget.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Three relational attention cores only; no CCFormer hierarchical history compression, local token-channel mixer, prediction head or complete paper reproduction. Returned user/history evidence is not overwritten by target outputs. Gradients still flow unless the caller detaches tensors; no target-to-target attention. Absent key/query sides return zero and false availability; independent softmax sums to one only on valid query/key rows. Caller owns pre-decision temporal validity.

method_cards.mechanism: Filter the complete item-discount calendar in frequency space; pool purchase attributes using target-conditioned item attention, apply a promotion-context gate, and concatenate preference with filtered/residual histories.
method_cards.comparison: Keep the interest backbone, features and budget fixed; compare branch removal and one history/user/context ablation chosen by measured residuals. Test simpler time-domain or pooled controls before attributing benefit to frequency filtering.
method_cards.failure_signals: Gains rely on future/realized labels as inputs, disappear with a fixed control or held-out slices, worsen calibration/cost, or require unsupported input semantics.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Independent DANet-inspired DPN core, not the production IPN, tokenizer or full Tmall system. Caller supplies target/item embeddings and aligned purchase discount/category/price attributes. Uses the declared history length for rFFT/irFFT; packed real/imaginary MLP, one FFN masked-softmax attention and a sigmoid context gate are explicit engineering choices. No silent 400/32/97 conversion, multihead DCM reproduction or guaranteed low-pass property. Calendar-aligned history slots are zero-filled for filtering and remasked afterward. Missing slots remain unknown business observations; host owns cutoff, missingness interpretation and sensitivity checks. Observed discount ratios must use a consistent [0,1] convention. Invalid padding is sanitized before operations, including NaNs; empty purchase or history signals contribute zero. No treatment-effect or causal debiasing guarantee.

method_cards.mechanism: Combine the existing interest and discount representations for a conversion logit; predict discount from the discount representation and optionally train it with valid-purchase-only supervision.
method_cards.comparison: Compare conversion-only alpha=0 with a prespecified nonzero auxiliary weight using identical forward structure and labels. Inspect positive-label coverage, conversion calibration and fixed business metrics; never compare losses with different units as evidence of gain.
method_cards.failure_signals: Gains rely on future/realized labels as inputs, disappear with a fixed control or held-out slices, worsen calibration/cost, or require unsupported input semantics.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Independent conversion/discount heads on caller-supplied interest and discount representations; this class does not create the IPN, DPN, embeddings, data pipeline or trainer. objective combines mean BCE-with-logits with alpha times MSE over purchased rows having a valid realized-discount label. The auxiliary denominator is the count of those rows; no valid positive gives differentiable zero. This reduction is an explicit interpretation of the paper. Conversion labels are binary and valid discount labels lie in [0,1]. Label tensors are detached; unavailable and nonpurchase discount labels are masked before arithmetic. Forward prediction takes no labels. Current-order realized discount must never enter the input representation. Response prediction and positive-only regression do not identify individual treatment effects or prove coupon profitability. Alpha=0 is the objective ablation control.

method_cards.mechanism: At each layer, add x0*(W*x+b)*sigmoid(G*x) to the current hidden state, retaining the initial feature vector.
method_cards.comparison: Keep host embeddings, head, objective, data split and budget fixed; compare this local block with its ablation and a parameter/latency-matched simpler control. Report supported slices, gradients and branch redundancy.
method_cards.when_to_try: Context or field-slice residuals suggest selective multiplicative processing. First compare with the existing local cross/MLP control.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Coordinate-gated matrix cross block only; no learned FDO embedding dimensions, deep tower or classifier. All dense inputs must be defined; host owns feature preparation and training.

method_cards.mechanism: Generate an unbounded nonlinear coordinate mask from original features, multiply current hidden state, then project, optionally normalize and ReLU.
method_cards.comparison: Keep host embeddings, head, objective, data split and budget fixed; compare this local block with its ablation and a parameter/latency-matched simpler control. Report supported slices, gradients and branch redundancy.
method_cards.when_to_try: Context or field-slice residuals suggest selective multiplicative processing. First compare with the existing local cross/MLP control.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: One reusable MaskBlock; serial composition reuses original features, parallel composition uses explicitly declared independent/shared instances and host fusion. No automatic feature embedding layer, batch norm, dropout or classifier.

method_cards.mechanism: Scale input features by twice sigmoid of a context-conditioned two-layer ReLU gate, independently instantiated per stream.
method_cards.comparison: Keep host embeddings, head, objective, data split and budget fixed; compare this local block with its ablation and a parameter/latency-matched simpler control. Report supported slices, gradients and branch redundancy.
method_cards.when_to_try: Two existing streams show complementary supported residuals. Test mid-layer exchange or fusion while preserving both input branches.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Host supplies the context; constant contexts produce global gates. Uses existing gating primitive as an explicit stream interface; no pair of MLP towers is created.

method_cards.mechanism: Fuse two representations with affine contributions and separate bilinear parameter tensors for matching contiguous head partitions.
method_cards.comparison: Keep host embeddings, head, objective, data split and budget fixed; compare this local block with its ablation and a parameter/latency-matched simpler control. Report supported slices, gradients and branch redundancy.
method_cards.when_to_try: Two existing streams show complementary supported residuals. Test mid-layer exchange or fusion while preserving both input branches.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Both stream widths must divide by heads; cross-head bilinear terms are excluded. Extends existing single bilinear scoring with a fusion contract; no softmax attention, sigmoid output or branch construction.

method_cards.mechanism: Communicate cross/deep intermediate states through product, sum, projected concatenation or two independently parameterized attention gates.
method_cards.comparison: Keep host embeddings, head, objective, data split and budget fixed; compare this local block with its ablation and a parameter/latency-matched simpler control. Report supported slices, gradients and branch redundancy.
method_cards.when_to_try: Two existing streams show complementary supported residuals. Test mid-layer exchange or fusion while preserving both input branches.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Single bridge at a host-selected depth; no entire EDCN network. Attention deliberately uses distinct gates for the two streams, correcting pinned upstream reuse of attention1. Gate MLP final biases are enabled.

method_cards.mechanism: Apply two learned temperature-softmax field weight vectors, each shared across embedding coordinates, to form cross/deep inputs.
method_cards.comparison: Keep host embeddings, head, objective, data split and budget fixed; compare this local block with its ablation and a parameter/latency-matched simpler control. Report supported slices, gradients and branch redundancy.
method_cards.when_to_try: Context or field-slice residuals suggest selective multiplicative processing. First compare with the existing local cross/MLP control.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Global field regulation rather than sample-adaptive routing; preserves field axis. No batch normalization; host pairs this block with independently evaluated bridge/cross/deep updates.

method_cards.mechanism: Normalize low-rank Gram features X*(X^T*P), transform them into tokens with a ReLU MLP, concatenate linear field compression and add a projected residual.
method_cards.comparison: Keep host embeddings, head, objective, data split and budget fixed; compare this local block with its ablation and a parameter/latency-matched simpler control. Report supported slices, gradients and branch redundancy.
method_cards.when_to_try: Context or field-slice residuals suggest selective multiplicative processing. First compare with the existing local cross/MLP control.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: A single FMB+LCB block with a two-layer FMB MLP; no tokenizer, model stack or head. Compressed Gram avoids forming the full field-pair matrix; no measured speed or scaling-law claim. Fully defined field tokens required; optional final normalization, Gram normalization always enabled.

method_cards.mechanism: Compute lexicographic i<j field-pair scores using a distinct matrix e_i^T*M_ij*e_j or vector-weighted product for each pair.
method_cards.comparison: Keep host embeddings, head, objective, data split and budget fixed; compare this local block with its ablation and a parameter/latency-matched simpler control. Report supported slices, gradients and branch redundancy.
method_cards.when_to_try: Known field identities and supported pair/group errors justify distinct partner parameters. Compare shared-bank and pair-specific encodings under a memory ceiling.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Uses host embeddings and returns pair scores without first-order terms or a classifier. Adds explicit field-pair parameter sharing policy to existing bilinear primitives; matrix storage grows quadratically in field count and embedding dimension.

method_cards.mechanism: Combine weighted within-group FM vectors with weighted products between pooled semantic groups.
method_cards.comparison: Keep host embeddings, head, objective, data split and budget fixed; compare this local block with its ablation and a parameter/latency-matched simpler control. Report supported slices, gradients and branch redundancy.
method_cards.when_to_try: Known field identities and supported pair/group errors justify distinct partner parameters. Compare shared-bank and pair-specific encodings under a memory ceiling.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Group IDs per field must be contiguous nonnegative integers and cover at least two nonempty groups; singleton within-group terms are zero. Generalizes the pinned three user/item/context groups; host supplies meaningful groups, linear terms, deep path and classifier.

method_cards.mechanism: Split an affine projection into a,b and emit a+a*b or concat(a,a*b), preserving factorized multiplicative interactions.
method_cards.comparison: Keep host embeddings, head, objective, data split and budget fixed; compare this local block with its ablation and a parameter/latency-matched simpler control. Report supported slices, gradients and branch redundancy.
method_cards.when_to_try: Lower-order controls underfit an interaction hypothesis on current fields. Increase order or factorization locally before enlarging the entire backbone.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Sum form is already expressible with LatentCross plus a projection; this is a convenience component and recipe boundary. Concat needs even output width; no FinalNet tower ensemble or detached consistency loss.

method_cards.mechanism: Split field coordinates into heads, multiply them by multiple ReLU-projected rows, sum rows, restore field-coordinate order and add the residual.
method_cards.comparison: Keep host embeddings, head, objective, data split and budget fixed; compare this local block with its ablation and a parameter/latency-matched simpler control. Report supported slices, gradients and branch redundancy.
method_cards.when_to_try: Lower-order controls underfit an interaction hypothesis on current fields. Increase order or factorization locally before enlarging the entire backbone.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Input width must divide into fields and each embedding width must divide into heads. Restores original coordinate order before residual, deliberately correcting pinned source direct flattening of head-major products. Projected row storage uses row/field/head/coordinate order. No batch norm, dropout or self-ensemble objective; compare head/row parameterization against existing multiplicative gates.

method_cards.mechanism: Generate a per-example full linear matrix or low-rank center S(condition) between shared input/output factors, with optional generated bias and overparameterized shared factors.
method_cards.comparison: Keep host embeddings, head, objective, data split and budget fixed; compare this local block with its ablation and a parameter/latency-matched simpler control. Report supported slices, gradients and branch redundancy.
method_cards.when_to_try: Current context/priors are available before decision and supported slices indicate parameter heterogeneity. Compare full/shared/low-rank or detached gate paths separately.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Extension of installed APG core as a reusable hidden-state layer; affine generator, no multilayer APG tower or final predictor. Generated bias follows flattened generated matrix in this independent parameter layout. Rank cannot exceed input/output dimensions; overparameterization requires rank. Host explicitly supplies condition (including layer(x,x) for self-conditioning), scenario semantics and training.

method_cards.mechanism: Scale a hidden layer by twice sigmoid of a ReLU MLP over base features and prior features; optionally detach only the base-feature gate path.
method_cards.comparison: Keep host embeddings, head, objective, data split and budget fixed; compare this local block with its ablation and a parameter/latency-matched simpler control. Report supported slices, gradients and branch redundancy.
method_cards.when_to_try: Current context/priors are available before decision and supported slices indicate parameter heterogeneity. Compare full/shared/low-rank or detached gate paths separately.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Extends existing PEPNet gating with explicit prior inputs, per-depth reuse and a declared stop-gradient boundary. detach_features defaults True; hidden and prior paths remain differentiable. Host creates one gate per chosen depth. No prior embedding tables, EPNet, task tower or automatic stacking; upstream PEPNet.py itself is only a stub.

method_cards.mechanism: Dot each field i embedded for partner j with field j embedded for partner i, keeping the i<j pair axis.
method_cards.comparison: Compare genuine partner-specific embeddings with a repeated shared embedding bank at fixed head, reporting parameter and memory changes.
method_cards.when_to_try: Known field identities and supported pair/group errors justify distinct partner parameters. Compare shared-bank and pair-specific encodings under a memory ceiling.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Host creates partner-specific lookup/projection banks; this parameter-free core is not an FFM trainer or automatic ID tokenizer. Diagonal entries are unused by the pair output. Independent tensor mechanism reference; host owns preprocessing, embeddings, training, prediction head and dataset evaluation. No task-specific lift or speed claim.

method_cards.mechanism: Concatenate diagonal copy-operation embeddings with off-diagonal field-aware pair dot values.
method_cards.comparison: Compare operation-specific copy/pair banks with shared embeddings while fixing downstream DNN width and reporting parameter/storage cost.
method_cards.when_to_try: Known field identities and supported pair/group errors justify distinct partner parameters. Compare shared-bank and pair-specific encodings under a memory ceiling.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: ONNv2 tensor convention is explicit: diagonal is the copy operation, off-diagonal is the partner operation. No lookup bank, DNN or prediction head is added. Independent tensor mechanism reference; host owns preprocessing, embeddings, training, prediction head and dataset evaluation. No task-specific lift or speed claim.

method_cards.mechanism: Dynamic programming computes exact elementary symmetric products over distinct fields for one selected order.
method_cards.comparison: Compare order 2 with a prespecified higher order using identical embeddings/head; report any independent per-order embedding banks separately.
method_cards.when_to_try: Lower-order controls underfit an interaction hypothesis on current fields. Increase order or factorization locally before enlarging the entire backbone.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: One tensor bank and one order only; host combines independent orders/banks and linear terms. Products can overflow for extreme activations and high order. Independent tensor mechanism reference; host owns preprocessing, embeddings, training, prediction head and dataset evaluation. No task-specific lift or speed claim.

method_cards.mechanism: Power sums and Newton identities produce a concatenated readout of all elementary symmetric interaction orders 1..K.
method_cards.comparison: Compare all-order readout with matched selected-order HOFM or the order-2 control; keep the host head/deep path fixed.
method_cards.when_to_try: Lower-order controls underfit an interaction hypothesis on current fields. Increase order or factorization locally before enlarging the entire backbone.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Same polynomials as HOFM, with an all-order composition and power-sum implementation; not a new generic MLP. K<=min(5,F). No BatchNorm, head or parallel deep branch; cancellation is possible at large scales. Independent tensor mechanism reference; host owns preprocessing, embeddings, training, prediction head and dataset evaluation. No task-specific lift or speed claim.

method_cards.mechanism: Real FFT pair multiplication followed by inverse FFT yields circular convolution, or correlation by conjugating the left spectrum.
method_cards.comparison: Compare circular convolution/correlation against Hadamard pair products with the same embedding dimension and host aggregation.
method_cards.when_to_try: An explicit product or geometric hypothesis remains unexplained by simple pairwise controls. Compare the new algebra with the same representation width and numerical scale.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Circular embedding-coordinate interactions, not chronological convolution. Explicit inverse length supports odd D; half inputs promote. No source classifier or HFM projection head. Independent tensor mechanism reference; host owns preprocessing, embeddings, training, prediction head and dataset evaluation. No task-specific lift or speed claim.

method_cards.mechanism: Append the projected dense representation as a field, compute all sparse/dense pair dots, then append the dense vector itself.
method_cards.comparison: Compare dot composition with dense/sparse concatenation under identical bottom representation and top-head budget.
method_cards.when_to_try: Use an explicit simple control or combine actual dense and sparse representations without inventing token semantics.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Composition of existing dot products; host supplies dense bottom MLP, sparse embeddings and top prediction head. Dense token is always observed; only sparse fields have a mask. Independent tensor mechanism reference; host owns preprocessing, embeddings, training, prediction head and dataset evaluation. No task-specific lift or speed claim.

method_cards.mechanism: Lift each embedding to the unit hyperboloid time component and return LorentzFM triangle interaction values for field pairs.
method_cards.comparison: Compare Lorentz triangle terms with Euclidean dot pairs using the same embeddings/head and controlled embedding norms.
method_cards.when_to_try: An explicit product or geometric hypothesis remains unexplained by simple pairwise controls. Compare the new algebra with the same representation width and numerical scale.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Curvature fixed at one, no manifold optimizer or learned geometric projection. Float64 intermediates protect float32 squares, but extreme float64 values can overflow and performance is unmeasured. Independent tensor mechanism reference; host owns preprocessing, embeddings, training, prediction head and dataset evaluation. No task-specific lift or speed claim.

method_cards.mechanism: Learn field-axis interaction orders in log(abs(x)) space and exponentiate their bounded linear combinations.
method_cards.comparison: Compare learned orders with fixed pair products or a linear field mixer at matched hidden width; inspect clipping frequency.
method_cards.when_to_try: An explicit product or geometric hypothesis remains unexplained by simple pairwise controls. Compare the new algebra with the same representation width and numerical scale.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Sign is discarded; epsilon floors magnitudes and exponent clipping saturates gradients. Missing fields are multiplicative-neutral, all-missing output zero. Omits AFN log/exp BatchNorm and ensemble DNN. Independent tensor mechanism reference; host owns preprocessing, embeddings, training, prediction head and dataset evaluation. No task-specific lift or speed claim.

method_cards.mechanism: Apply shared learned field orders to log magnitudes and phases, reconstruct real/imaginary outputs and add a shared implicit ReLU projection.
method_cards.comparison: Compare explicit polar products alone, implicit projection alone and their sum with matched representations and host head.
method_cards.when_to_try: An explicit product or geometric hypothesis remains unexplained by simple pairwise controls. Compare the new algebra with the same representation width and numerical scale.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Host supplies real/imaginary tensors; no initial semantic embedding conversion, dropout, normalization or head. Zero phase is explicitly defined with zero gradient near zero, magnitudes floored, exponents clipped. Missing fields are multiplicative-neutral. Independent tensor mechanism reference; host owns preprocessing, embeddings, training, prediction head and dataset evaluation. No task-specific lift or speed claim.

method_cards.mechanism: Fuse full initial-field/current-subspace outer products with learned alpha, multiply by output-specific channel matrices, and contract a learned channel vector.
method_cards.comparison: Compare learned subspace fusion and full channel matrices against fixed fusion and diagonal matrices, holding token counts/head fixed.
method_cards.when_to_try: An explicit product or geometric hypothesis remains unexplained by simple pairwise controls. Compare the new algebra with the same representation width and numerical scale.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: One generalized interaction layer only. Initial and current token axes remain explicit; no parallel DNN or complete AOANet stack. Full O*D*D matrices can be costly. Independent tensor mechanism reference; host owns preprocessing, embeddings, training, prediction head and dataset evaluation. No task-specific lift or speed claim.

method_cards.mechanism: Pool each interaction order, update fields with the pooled vector multiplied by the fixed initial contextual tokens, then attention-pool across orders.
method_cards.comparison: Compare one order with recurrent orders and uniform versus learned pooling using the same contextualized input and prediction head.
method_cards.when_to_try: Field tokens are available and context-dependent connectivity or order aggregation is a testable bottleneck. Measure field-order and attention-path ablations.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Consumes host contextual X1; omits upstream initial self-attention/FFN and classifier. Learned local aggregators use hidden width D. No claim that higher orders improve held-out outcomes. Independent tensor mechanism reference; host owns preprocessing, embeddings, training, prediction head and dataset evaluation. No task-specific lift or speed claim.

method_cards.mechanism: Build a learned directed field graph without self edges, send through per-field output matrices and receive through per-field input matrices, with residual.
method_cards.comparison: Compare learned graph weights with uniform valid-neighbor weights and shared versus field-specific matrices at fixed propagation depth.
method_cards.when_to_try: Field tokens are available and context-dependent connectivity or order aggregation is a testable bottleneck. Measure field-order and attention-path ablations.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: One non-GRU propagation step, no extra initial residual, multi-step reuse or task head; bias omitted from messages. A graph over fields is not a user-item graph. Isolated valid fields retain their residual. Independent tensor mechanism reference; host owns preprocessing, embeddings, training, prediction head and dataset evaluation. No task-specific lift or speed claim.

method_cards.mechanism: Center Q/K over valid fields per head and add separately normalized pair attention and unary key attention.
method_cards.comparison: Compare pair-only, unary-only and their sum at fixed head count and projection width.
method_cards.when_to_try: Field tokens are available and context-dependent connectivity or order aggregation is a testable bottleneck. Measure field-order and attention-path ablations.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Correct [B,H,F,d] head transpose replaces source direct view; both distributions sum to one so combined row mass is two. No residual, dropout, optional pre-attention ReLU or classifier. Valid centering respects padding. Independent tensor mechanism reference; host owns preprocessing, embeddings, training, prediction head and dataset evaluation. No task-specific lift or speed claim.

method_cards.mechanism: Multiply raw pair dots by learned pair vectors (A) or elementwise pair vectors (E); order-3 variants transform keys, aggregate neighbors and optionally add a projection residual.
method_cards.comparison: Compare 2A/2E and 3A/3E at declared pair/vector storage cost, separating residual and output aggregation choices.
method_cards.when_to_try: Field tokens are available and context-dependent connectivity or order aggregation is a testable bottleneck. Measure field-order and attention-path ablations.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: All four local variants supported; no softmax, dropout or final weighted/sum/concat aggregation. Self pairs are included, unlike strict upper-triangle FM pair outputs. Independent tensor mechanism reference; host owns preprocessing, embeddings, training, prediction head and dataset evaluation. No task-specific lift or speed claim.

method_cards.mechanism: Wide convolution along the ordered field axis, independently select largest k positions per channel/coordinate, restore their source order, then tanh.
method_cards.comparison: Compare ordered convolution/k-max with no convolution or ordinary max pooling, including a field-order shuffle control.
method_cards.when_to_try: A defensible stable field order exists; compare order permutations, generated-field removal and a non-convolutional matched-capacity control.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: One stage with explicit k, no source dynamic multi-stage schedule or task head. Host must justify field order. Missing inputs are zero-filled; empty receptive fields cannot win and unavailable top-k slots become zero. Independent tensor mechanism reference; host owns preprocessing, embeddings, training, prediction head and dataset evaluation. No task-specific lift or speed claim.

method_cards.mechanism: Length-preserving field convolution, tanh and max pooling feed a learned flattened recombination that creates new field tokens.
method_cards.comparison: Compare original fields with original plus generated fields at matched downstream interaction budget, ablating convolution and recombination separately.
method_cards.when_to_try: A defensible stable field order exists; compare order permutations, generated-field removal and a non-convolutional matched-capacity control.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: One stage, odd kernels, right-padded final pooling window, generated tokens only. No BatchNorm, source multistage schedule, original-field concatenation or head. All-absent samples yield zero. Independent tensor mechanism reference; host owns preprocessing, embeddings, training, prediction head and dataset evaluation. No task-specific lift or speed claim.

method_cards.mechanism: Append the candidate token to history, add learned positions, then apply bidirectional multihead self-attention and residual feed-forward refinement. Expose transformed history and candidate readout.
method_cards.comparison: Keep the same events, embedding width and training budget; compare candidate-in-encoder with history-only encoding followed by target attention. Test positional contribution separately.
method_cards.when_to_try: Real ordered histories and candidate features are available. Test candidate inclusion, causal refinement or separate user/item matching rather than treating numeric columns as events.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: One Transformer block with target-token pooling; excludes source concat/mean/sum readouts and causal-mask option. No-history target readout is deliberately zero rather than a target-only prediction; retain target-only information in a host branch. Host supplies time-safe embeddings, ordered histories, prediction heads, task loss and evaluator; this is an independent mechanism reference, not a complete production clone. True=valid; invalid history values are sanitized, all-masked/empty readouts are zero. No training experiment or effectiveness claim.

method_cards.mechanism: Causally refine events, compute a second head-split self-attention, expand each head separately, then use independent target/position-conditioned DIN-style attentions to form multiple interests.
method_cards.comparison: Compare one head and multiple heads at matched budget, then ablate the causal behavior refiner while retaining target attentions. Auxiliary transition loss is a separate experiment.
method_cards.when_to_try: Real ordered histories and candidate features are available. Test candidate inclusion, causal refinement or separate user/item matching rather than treating numeric columns as events.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Independent two-normalization refiner and D-dimensional positional context; no dropout or upstream exact hidden-width choices. The host constructs auxiliary next-event/negative supervision; intermediate refined/head states are exposed and remain event-aligned. Host supplies time-safe embeddings, ordered histories, prediction heads, task loss and evaluator; this is an independent mechanism reference, not a complete production clone. True=valid; invalid history values are sanitized, all-masked/empty readouts are zero. No training experiment or effectiveness claim.

method_cards.mechanism: Context/position-conditioned scores form causal prefix user states; their final valid state matches the target by a dot product. A separate target/context-conditioned item path returns both softmax history pooling and the sum of raw relevance scores.
method_cards.comparison: On aligned events and context, compare user path only, item path only and both. Keep the loss fixed, then test next-event user-state supervision separately.
method_cards.when_to_try: Real ordered histories and candidate features are available. Test candidate inclusion, causal refinement or separate user/item matching rather than treating numeric columns as events.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Optional side context must be event-aligned; omission supplies zero side context, not fabricated business features. Separate input/output item embedding tables, calibrated heads and next-event objective are host-owned. Uses the last valid prefix rather than the last padded array slot. Host supplies time-safe embeddings, ordered histories, prediction heads, task loss and evaluator; this is an independent mechanism reference, not a complete production clone. True=valid; invalid history values are sanitized, all-masked/empty readouts are zero. No training experiment or effectiveness claim.

method_cards.mechanism: Learned target/history dot scores create an unnormalized coarse weighted sum, including negative contributions; valid-only top-K retrieval feeds a separate learned target-attention fine readout.
method_cards.comparison: Compare the same fine attention under random/recency/learned selection at fixed K; then add coarse-head supervision without changing selectors or fine structure.
method_cards.when_to_try: Measured history cost or signal dilution motivates selection. Compare exact scoring, recency and random-at-equal-k controls; measure useful-event coverage and latency as well as response.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Hard indices are nondifferentiable; the coarse representation and scores expose a trainable route for selector supervision. Masks rank invalid events below every finite valid score, correcting source padding that can beat negative scores. Coarse/fine heads, losses and short-history branch remain host-owned. Dense O(L) score scan; fixed K outputs, stable ties favor earlier event indices. Invalid indices are -1. Host supplies time-safe embeddings, ordered histories, prediction heads, task loss and evaluator; this is an independent mechanism reference, not a complete production clone. True=valid; invalid history values are sanitized, all-masked/empty readouts are zero. No training experiment or effectiveness claim.

method_cards.mechanism: Fixed checkpointed random-hyperplane signs yield Hamming distance from target; retrieve nearest K valid history events and apply learned target attention.
method_cards.comparison: Fix K, history and fine readout; compare Hamming retrieval with learned similarity, recency and random eligible retrieval. Treat hash seed as an experimental seed.
method_cards.when_to_try: Measured history cost or signal dilution motivates selection. Compare exact scoring, recency and random-at-equal-k controls; measure useful-event coverage and latency as well as response.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Dense Hamming scan, not an ANN serving index. Hash bits are discrete and non-trainable; no stochastic per-batch rehashing. Stable ties use original order; fixed K invalid slots are -1/False/zero. Hash distance reports zero at invalid events and must be interpreted with the input valid mask. Host supplies time-safe embeddings, ordered histories, prediction heads, task loss and evaluator; this is an independent mechanism reference, not a complete production clone. True=valid; invalid history values are sanitized, all-masked/empty readouts are zero. No training experiment or effectiveness claim.

method_cards.mechanism: Sum history embeddings whose full random-hyperplane bit code equals the target code independently for each hash; average the hash-specific sums.
method_cards.comparison: At fixed history and projection seed, compare exact collision pooling with top-K Hamming selection and masked mean; measure empty-bucket rate and cost.
method_cards.when_to_try: Measured history cost or signal dilution motivates selection. Compare exact scoring, recency and random-at-equal-k controls; measure useful-event coverage and latency as well as response.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Preserves the unnormalized source option; no optional per-hash L2 normalization. Collision sums are not event means or learned attention. No trainable parameters inside this component: gradients flow to collided history embeddings; discrete bucket membership does not train target/hash rotations. No ANN index. Host supplies time-safe embeddings, ordered histories, prediction heads, task loss and evaluator; this is an independent mechanism reference, not a complete production clone. True=valid; invalid history values are sanitized, all-masked/empty readouts are zero. No training experiment or effectiveness claim.

method_cards.mechanism: Each learned query/key head chooses its own top-K history events; exactly those scores normalize corresponding value heads, then concatenated head outputs are projected.
method_cards.comparison: Compare headwise selections against a common shared-K selection with matched q/k/v width, then ablate retrieval/fine-score consistency.
method_cards.when_to_try: Measured history cost or signal dilution motivates selection. Compare exact scoring, recency and random-at-equal-k controls; measure useful-event coverage and latency as well as response.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Dense search, without production ANN caches or the full short/long dual-branch ranker. Hard selection indices are nondifferentiable. Fixed K per head; every head reports original event indices, masks and weights. Invalid indices are -1, and all-masked heads remain zero. Host supplies time-safe embeddings, ordered histories, prediction heads, task loss and evaluator; this is an independent mechanism reference, not a complete production clone. True=valid; invalid history values are sanitized, all-masked/empty readouts are zero. No training experiment or effectiveness claim.

method_cards.mechanism: Target, masked recent-history mean and global-history mean independently query fixed LSH top-K; original indices are restored to temporal order. Each selected stream receives masked complex block-channel FFT refinement, pooled interests and final target attention.
method_cards.comparison: Compare target-only with three selector queries, then compare identity/no-filter control against frequency refinement at identical selected indices. Keep K, hashes and serving cost recorded.
method_cards.when_to_try: Measured history cost or signal dilution motivates selection. Compare exact scoring, recency and random-at-equal-k controls; measure useful-event coverage and latency as well as response.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Corrects unused selection masks and diagonal-only einsum: full off-diagonal channel mixing is deliberate and independently implemented. Orthogonal rFFT/irFFT with explicit n=K supports odd K; complex matrices are shared across frequencies. Zero-padded invalid slots are part of the declared K-point transform, masked both before FFT and after residual LayerNorm. Omits upstream recency-position additions, dropout and short-history attention branch. Recent mask must be a subset of valid; missing recent history produces no recent interest. Dense hash scans, no ANN cache. Fixed K with chronological valid selections and invalid -1 slots. Host supplies time-safe embeddings, ordered histories, prediction heads, task loss and evaluator; this is an independent mechanism reference, not a complete production clone. True=valid; invalid history values are sanitized, all-masked/empty readouts are zero. No training experiment or effectiveness claim.

method_cards.mechanism: Supervise aggregated branch logits or probabilities and add separately summed branch BCE against a detached ensemble teacher.
method_cards.comparison: Hold branch architecture and predictions fixed; ablate consistency weight and compare logit versus probability aggregation separately, reporting each loss and calibration.
method_cards.when_to_try: Host can expose the required logits/states/parameters. A learning or gradient observation motivates changing an objective while retaining the backbone.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Teacher is detached; aggregate supervised path remains differentiable. The weight multiplies a SUM of branch means, so branch count changes its scale. Probability averaging uses stable log probabilities; neither aggregation is a causal effect estimator.

method_cards.mechanism: Score aligned state-positive and state-negative pairs with a shared MLP; average BCE over both classes and valid transitions only.
method_cards.comparison: Keep main model and sampler fixed; compare main loss only with a weighted auxiliary term, then test negative strategy separately. Audit false negatives and future leakage.
method_cards.when_to_try: Host can expose the required logits/states/parameters. A learning or gradient observation motivates changing an objective while retaining the backbone.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Host aligns state t with event t+1 and supplies time-safe negatives. Inputs are already shifted; this module does not shift a second time. Mask is applied to unreduced positive and negative losses. Empty/all-masked transitions give differentiable zero. Host must expose sequence states from the candidate.

method_cards.mechanism: Apply independently weighted binary supervision to coarse and fine response logits for the same observed target.
method_cards.comparison: Keep selector, fine head and retained history fixed; isolate coarse loss weight and measure retrieval coverage alongside final task quality.
method_cards.when_to_try: Host can expose the required logits/states/parameters. A learning or gradient observation motivates changing an objective while retaining the backbone.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Host builds both prediction heads. Retrieval scores alone are not response logits. Does not make hard top-k differentiable; report which selection parameters receive gradients.

method_cards.mechanism: Add explicit lambda/p times the sum of absolute parameter values to power p, separately for embedding and network groups.
method_cards.comparison: Keep optimizer and architecture fixed; vary one regularization group at a time, recording loss contribution, gradient scale and slice support.
method_cards.when_to_try: Host can expose the required logits/states/parameters. A learning or gradient observation motivates changing an objective while retaining the backbone.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: This is an explicit loss penalty, not decoupled AdamW. Host supplies disjoint parameter objects and chooses whether to exclude bias and normalization. Never double-count the same penalty in optimizer weight decay; group identity checks do not detect storage aliases.

method_cards.mechanism: Initialize, sum, or concatenate aligned pretrained ID vectors with a learned ID path and project to the declared output width.
method_cards.comparison: Use the same vocabulary and pretrained table; isolate fusion mode and freezing, then compare cold/OOV and frequent-ID slices.
method_cards.when_to_try: A versioned aligned pretrained table and sparse/cold slice evidence exist. Test fusion and freezing independently with constant ID mapping.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Host aligns IDs and validates vocabulary version, padding and OOV coverage. Inputs are native integer IDs. Freezing changes pretrained gradients only: it must not silently discard appended OOV vectors or switch the inference representation.

method_cards.mechanism: Apply a raw-logit affine head when hidden_dims is empty, or a ReLU MLP for a declared sequence of hidden widths.
method_cards.comparison: Keep input encoding and objective fixed; use this as the no-extra-structure or capacity-matched control for a candidate component.
method_cards.when_to_try: Use an explicit simple control or combine actual dense and sparse representations without inventing token semantics.
method_cards.failure_signals: Missing or mistimed inputs; ineffective gradients; unsupported slices; instability, unacceptable cost, or no gain against the declared ablation.
method_cards.implementation_boundary: Generic LR/DNN control or host prediction head; no tokenizer, implicit sigmoid or causal interpretation.
